title: Hearty Irish Mushroom Stew
description: A vegetarian take on the classic Irish beef stew, featuring sautéed mushrooms and root vegetables in a rich broth.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion, carrots, and celery; cook until tender.
Add mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add vegetable broth, whisking continuously.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer.
Return to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Add potatoes and continue to simmer for another 15-20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
